implementation.scope: Bounded UTF-16 token extraction preserving live cursor, scratch GPRs, CR6, low-32-bit guest addressing and the full-width r31 spill/restore.

validation.tested_scope: Empty, ordinary, leading space/tab, quoted, empty quoted, quoted escape, escape terminal, literal backslash with low-32-bit-zero r6, unquoted and quoted capacity limits; high GPR/SP/LR bits, r31 spill/restore, ordinary RAM and selected GPR/CR/XER.
validation.unvalidated_scope: Other inputs and aliasing, faults, MMIO, concurrent mutation, unselected ABI state and runtime behavior.
